## Concepts to keep nearby

| Concept | First covered in |
|---------|------------------|
| Client–server, HTTP, ports | Lecture 01–02 |
| Embedded Tomcat, `@RestController` | Lecture 02 |
| POM, GAV, lifecycle | Lecture 03 |
| DI, IoC, loose coupling | Lecture 04 |
| Beans, `@Component`, `@Bean`, `@Autowired` | Lecture 05 |
| Circular deps, scopes, `@Lazy` / eager | Lecture 06 |
| Bean lifecycle, `@PostConstruct` / `@PreDestroy` | Lecture 07 |
| XML config, `ClassPathXmlApplicationContext` | Lecture 08 |
| `@SpringBootApplication`, starters, auto-config | Lecture 09 |
| Properties, `@Value`, runners | Lecture 10 |
| CRUD API → JPA → soft delete | Lectures 11–13 |
| Servlets & Spring MVC | Lectures 14–15 |
| DTOs, errors, profiles, filters, interceptors | Lectures 16–21 |
| AOP | Lectures 22–25 |
| JDBC → JPA → transactions | Lectures 26–34 |
| Security, JWT, OAuth | Lectures 35–39 |
| Testing & production projects | Lectures 40–42 |
